Action: get_schema({})

Observation: Project food_health_viz {
  database_type: 'DuckDB'
}

Table establishment_keys {
  slchd_establishment_key varchar [pk, note: 'NAME|ADDRESS|CITY']
  name varchar [not null]
  address varchar [not null]
  city varchar [not null]
  city_state_zip varchar
  establishment_type varchar
  source varchar [note: 'friend_slc | own_scrape']
  slchd_lat double
  slchd_lon double
  geocode_status varchar [note: 'Match | Match_Nominatim | No_Match | Tie']

  Note: 'SLCHD establishment list, one row per portal listing.'
}

Table category {
  category_id integer [pk]
  category varchar
}

Table establishments {
  gmap_id varchar [pk]
  name varchar
  address varchar
  description varchar
  geom geometry [note: 'ST_Point(longitude, latitude), spatial extension']
  avg_rating double
  num_of_reviews integer
  price varchar
  slchd_establishment_key varchar [ref: > establishment_keys.slchd_establishment_key, note: 'nullable; set when ER matched']

  Note: 'One row per Google Local place — all restaurants, not just SLCHD-matched.'
}

Table establishment_attributes {
  gmap_id varchar [ref: > establishments.gmap_id, not null]
  attribute varchar [not null]

  indexes { (gmap_id, attribute) [pk] }

  Note: 'Flattened meta.MISC leaf values. Outer category label (e.g. "Service options") dropped.'
}

Table establishment_categories {
  gmap_id varchar [ref: > establishments.gmap_id, not null]
  category_id integer [ref: > category.category_id, not null]

  indexes { (gmap_id, category_id) [pk] }
}

Table gmap_hours {
  gmap_id varchar [ref: > establishments.gmap_id, not null]
  day integer [not null, note: '0=Sun … 6=Sat']
  open_min bigint
  open_max bigint

  indexes { (gmap_id, day) [pk] }

  Note: 'Covers every meta place with parsable hours, not just the SLCHD-matched subset.'
}

Table review {
  user_id varchar
  name varchar
  time bigint
  rating double
  text varchar
  resp varchar
  gmap_id varchar [ref: > establishments.gmap_id]
}

Table inspection_types {
  inspection_type_id integer [pk, note: 'parsed leading number, e.g. "01 - Routine" -> 1']
  description varchar [note: 'e.g. "Routine"']
}

Table inspections {
  inspection_id bigint [pk, increment]
  slchd_establishment_key varchar [ref: > establishment_keys.slchd_establishment_key, not null]
  inspection_date date [not null]
  inspection_type_id integer [ref: > inspection_types.inspection_type_id, note: 'nullable — 27 rows have no type']
  inspection_score integer

  Note: 'One row per inspection visit. count_critical/noncritical_violations dropped (derivable from violations).'
}

Table violation_codes {
  violation_code_id integer [pk, increment]
  code_text varchar [not null, note: 'base code, asterisks stripped, e.g. "4.5.18"']
  asterisk_count integer [not null, note: '0/1/2 trailing * in source, meaning unconfirmed']
  critical boolean [not null]
}

Table violations {
  violation_id bigint [pk, increment]
  inspection_id bigint [ref: > inspections.inspection_id, not null]
  violation_code_id integer [ref: > violation_codes.violation_code_id, not null]
  violation_description varchar [note: 'per-occurrence free text']
  violation_occurrences integer
  violation_cos boolean [note: 'corrected on site']
  violation_phr varchar [note: 'public health rationale']

  Note: 'One row per violation actually cited. Zero-violation inspections get zero rows (no placeholder row).'
}

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_inspections,
  COUNT(DISTINCT slchd_establishment_key) as total_establishments,
  AVG(inspection_score) as mean_score,
  MEDIAN(inspection_score) as median_score,
  STDDEV_SAMP(inspection_score) as stddev_score,
  MIN(inspection_score) as min_score,
  MAX(inspection_score) as max_score,
  QUANTILE_CONT(inspection_score, 0.25) as p25_score,
  QUANTILE_CONT(inspection_score, 0.75) as p75_score,
  QUANTILE_CONT(inspection_score, 0.90) as p90_score,
  QUANTILE_CONT(inspection_score, 0.95) as p95_score
FROM inspections;

-- Facet 1: Score Distribution Buckets
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN inspection_score = 0 THEN '0 (Clean)'
    WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN '1-5 (Low Risk)'
    WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 (Moderate)'
    WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '11-20 (Elevated)'
    WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN '21-30 (High)'
    WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 31 AND 50 THEN '31-50 (Very High)'
    ELSE '51+ (Severe)'
  END AS score_range,
  COUNT(*) AS inspection_count,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inspections), 1) as percentage
FROM inspections
GROUP BY score_range
ORDER BY MIN(inspection_score);

SELECT 
  score_range,
  COUNT(*) AS inspection_count,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inspections), 1) as percentage
FROM (
  SELECT 
    inspection_score,
    CASE 
      WHEN inspection_score = 0 THEN '00 (0 Clean)'
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN '01 (1-5 Low Risk)'
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '02 (6-10 Moderate)'
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '03 (11-20 Elevated)'
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN '04 (21-30 High)'
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 31 AND 50 THEN '05 (31-50 Very High)'
      ELSE '06 (51+ Severe)'
    END AS score_range
  FROM inspections
) sub
GROUP BY score_range
ORDER BY score_range;

SELECT 
  COALESCE(it.description, 'Unknown') AS inspection_type,
  COUNT(i.inspection_id) AS total_inspections,
  ROUND(AVG(i.inspection_score), 2) AS avg_score,
  MEDIAN(i.inspection_score) AS median_score
FROM inspections i
LEFT JOIN inspection_types it ON i.inspection_type_id = it.inspection_type_id
GROUP BY COALESCE(it.description, 'Unknown')
ORDER BY total_inspections DESC;

SELECT 
  YEAR(inspection_date)::VARCHAR AS inspection_year,
  COUNT(*) AS total_inspections,
  ROUND(AVG(inspection_score), 2) AS avg_score,
  MEDIAN(inspection_score) AS median_score
FROM inspections
WHERE inspection_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY YEAR(inspection_date)
ORDER BY inspection_year;

WITH latest_inspections AS (
  SELECT 
    slchd_establishment_key,
    inspection_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY slchd_establishment_key ORDER BY inspection_date DESC, inspection_id DESC) as rn
  FROM inspections
)
SELECT 
  score_range,
  COUNT(*) AS establishment_count,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) as percentage
FROM (
  SELECT 
    inspection_score,
    CASE 
      WHEN inspection_score = 0 THEN '00 (0 Clean)'
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN '01 (1-5 Low Risk)'
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '02 (6-10 Moderate)'
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '03 (11-20 Elevated)'
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN '04 (21-30 High)'
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 31 AND 50 THEN '05 (31-50 Very High)'
      ELSE '06 (51+ Severe)'
    END AS score_range
  FROM latest_inspections
  WHERE rn = 1
) sub
GROUP BY score_range
ORDER BY score_range;

WITH latest_inspections AS (
  SELECT 
    slchd_establishment_key,
    inspection_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY slchd_establishment_key ORDER BY inspection_date DESC, inspection_id DESC) as rn
  FROM inspections
)
SELECT 
  MIN(inspection_score) as min_score,
  MAX(inspection_score) as max_score,
  AVG(inspection_score) as avg_score,
  MEDIAN(inspection_score) as median_score,
  QUANTILE_CONT(inspection_score, 0.25) as p25,
  QUANTILE_CONT(inspection_score, 0.75) as p75
FROM latest_inspections
WHERE rn = 1;

WITH latest_inspections AS (
  SELECT 
    slchd_establishment_key,
    inspection_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY slchd_establishment_key ORDER BY inspection_date DESC, inspection_id DESC) as rn
  FROM inspections
)
SELECT inspection_score, count(*) 
FROM latest_inspections 
WHERE rn = 1 
GROUP BY inspection_score 
ORDER BY inspection_score DESC;

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_inspections,
  COUNT(inspection_score) as non_null_scores,
  COUNT(*) - COUNT(inspection_score) as null_scores
FROM inspections;

SELECT 
  score_bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS inspection_count
FROM (
  SELECT 
    inspection_score,
    CASE 
      WHEN inspection_score = 0 THEN '0 (Clean)'
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN '1-5 (Low)'
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 (Moderate)'
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '11-20 (Elevated)'
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN '21-30 (High)'
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 31 AND 50 THEN '31-50 (Very High)'
      ELSE '51+ (Severe)'
    END AS score_bucket,
    CASE 
      WHEN inspection_score = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 1
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN 2
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN 3
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN 4
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 31 AND 50 THEN 5
      ELSE 6
    END AS bucket_order
  FROM inspections
  WHERE inspection_score IS NOT NULL
) sub
GROUP BY score_bucket, bucket_order
ORDER BY bucket_order;

SELECT 
  COALESCE(it.description, 'Unspecified') AS inspection_type,
  ROUND(AVG(i.inspection_score), 2) AS avg_inspection_score,
  COUNT(*) AS total_inspections
FROM inspections i
LEFT JOIN inspection_types it ON i.inspection_type_id = it.inspection_type_id
WHERE i.inspection_score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(it.description, 'Unspecified')
ORDER BY avg_inspection_score DESC;

SELECT 
  YEAR(inspection_date)::VARCHAR AS inspection_year,
  ROUND(AVG(inspection_score), 2) AS avg_inspection_score,
  MEDIAN(inspection_score) AS median_inspection_score,
  COUNT(*) AS total_inspections
FROM inspections
WHERE inspection_score IS NOT NULL 
  AND YEAR(inspection_date) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2025
GROUP BY YEAR(inspection_date)
ORDER BY inspection_year;

WITH latest_inspections AS (
  SELECT 
    slchd_establishment_key,
    inspection_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY slchd_establishment_key ORDER BY inspection_date DESC, inspection_id DESC) as rn
  FROM inspections
  WHERE inspection_score IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  score_bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS establishment_count
FROM (
  SELECT 
    inspection_score,
    CASE 
      WHEN inspection_score = 0 THEN '0 (Clean)'
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN '1-5 (Low Risk)'
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 (Moderate)'
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '11-20 (Elevated)'
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN '21-30 (High)'
      ELSE '31+ (Severe)'
    END AS score_bucket,
    CASE 
      WHEN inspection_score = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 1
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN 2
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN 3
      WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN 4
      ELSE 5
    END AS bucket_order
  FROM latest_inspections
  WHERE rn = 1
) sub
GROUP BY score_bucket, bucket_order
ORDER BY bucket_order;
